S03 adds shared and nested subgraph editing, stable interfaces, Structure authoring, and typed clipboard dependency transfer with atomic rejection and Undo/Redo. The Human Owner accepted the exact independently reviewed S03 scope; later commits preserve review evidence and record completion.

## Exact bindings

- Implementation I: `80ee116b8f809c9160aa9cc311801cce15923cee`
- Independently reviewed R: `c209bba451149b9d54a6a54c3b35dd28f39225f3` — review `S03-FR-c209bba-R2`, PASS, no remaining findings or required evidence gaps.
- Evidence persistence P: `04834e2d0c11656f9d06a3e9ab82350f6edede33`
- Completion bookkeeping B: `1cfa1e9e22fd37e0965640f33bf1d681917db754`
- Published head D: `aea7418232d9144a6aa32764d044960974b78fa4`
- Build: `S03-repair2-web-80ee116`, `production/evidence/s03/repair-02/candidate-web-01.tar.gz`, SHA256 `46cd7c70aba4139416173495453486a0d0ff8da41c2d10d7bd06a88329b4dc79`.

[Independent review](https://github.com/yeataro/Grape/blob/aea7418232d9144a6aa32764d044960974b78fa4/production/evidence/s03/acceptance-01/independent-review/INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_RESULT.json), [Human acceptance](https://github.com/yeataro/Grape/blob/aea7418232d9144a6aa32764d044960974b78fa4/production/evidence/coordinator/s03/human-acceptance-20261004-01.json), and [closeout result](https://github.com/yeataro/Grape/blob/aea7418232d9144a6aa32764d044960974b78fa4/production/evidence/acceptance/s03/closeout-20261004-01/closeout-result-01.json) bind all 24 mapped capabilities and AT-S03-01..04 to I/R. P/B/D do not claim a new product review.

## Validation and scope

- Independent review: 156 unit/conformance tests, 48 browser tests, 9 bootstrap tests, build/type/module checks, and a 30-case source-admission matrix passed.
- Root integrity: 463 checks, 411 indexed files and 412 frozen files. Exact B/D metadata candidates passed current-state validation and all 9 bootstrap tests. Reviewed source/tests/tools/config/build and prior evidence remain unchanged after R.
- Environment: Windows x64, Node 25.5.0, Playwright 1.62.1, Chromium 151.0.7922.34, 1440×1000. Native OS IME, touch/iPad/Safari, broad accessibility, native TD/runtime and physical GPU qualification are not claimed.
- Nested Structure arrays remain authored but explicitly fail the unsupported ES300 profile with no generated artifact; supported one-dimensional cases have WebGL2 evidence. Portable source-descriptor rules do not claim native runtime execution.
- S02 legacy AT-S02-03/G-VERSION-COMPAT, S04 Personal/G-PD-1, wider S05 catalog and other inherited residual Gates remain open; no global Gate closure.
- DEC-GRAPE-002/AC-GRAPE-001 are accepted future S04 requirements, not delivered S03 behavior. Their unissued draft is metadata only; the production writer remains `grape.document 2.0`.

Original raw evidence whitespace is preserved with explicit exceptions. The separate dirty local workspace has known README/fixture failures (7/9); it is not the published candidate, whose isolated checks passed 9/9. Subsequent DEC-GRAPE-003/AC-GRAPE-002, README additions, notes, references and publication receipts are excluded from this exact head. This PR does not itself activate S04.
